description: Reviewed individual resources and inspiration. External tools are optional; runtime and Tari compatibility are not verified.

resources.title: Godot All About VFX Bundle
resources.summary: Jettelly educational bundle about shaders, particles and visual effects for Godot.
resources.use_in_hub: Learn visual polish for game clients. Pricing and access follow the publisher.

resources.title: Forbidden Solitaire: design and launch study
resources.summary: Horror solitaire reference for genre mixing, presentation and expansion marketing.
resources.use_in_hub: Study the game and DLC campaign. This is inspiration, not a reusable game framework. The June 2025 wishlist post is a historical creator report, not a current metric.

resources.title: Blightrole: dice RPG design study
resources.summary: Nautilus Games horror RPG built around dice, roles, items and risky choices.
resources.use_in_hub: Study atmosphere and interactions between dice and passive abilities; no source code or assets are offered by this listing.

resources.title: VoiceStudio
resources.summary: Local voice tooling covering synthesis, voice design, dubbing and transcription.
resources.use_in_hub: Explore an optional voice-production workflow. Check supported engines, model terms and hardware before setup.

resources.title: Deadhand Theater: card combat and effects study
resources.summary: Bag Track Games poker-based roguelike deckbuilder with a theatrical visual identity.
resources.use_in_hub: Study card combat feedback and distinctive practical-style effects. Reference game, not a forkable starter.

resources.title: Balatro Feel: Mix and Jam Unity example
resources.summary: Unity example studying Balatro-inspired card movement and shader effects.
resources.use_in_hub: Study or adapt card presentation; requires Unity 2022.3+ and DOTween. This is a game-feel example, not the complete Balatro game.

resources.title: Edition Cards: Blender card materials
resources.summary: CMZW card-shader study with Blender materials and replaceable card artwork.
resources.use_in_hub: Explore card surface treatments in Blender 4.5 or later. Check the creator listing for current download and reuse terms.

resources.title: Cinematique: cinematic prompt reference
resources.summary: VVSVS reference library for cinematic language, framing, lighting and camera choices.
resources.use_in_hub: Develop prompts and shot briefs for creator trailers and generated footage; link to the library instead of copying its contents.

resources.title: SEO prompt workflow reference
resources.summary: Sarvesh Shrivastava article outlining prompts for business context, SEO audits and competitor research.
resources.use_in_hub: Adapt the questions for creator landing pages. Independently verify generated claims and measure results; promotional outcomes are not guarantees.

resources.title: AI game-level workflow: Stefan 3D AI
resources.summary: Video walkthrough from environment concept and model creation through textures, UVs, PBR materials, Blender assembly and Unreal setup.
resources.use_in_hub: Follow as a learning workflow; the title describes free tools, but linked services can have paid tiers and changing limits.

resources.title: Tripo Studio
resources.summary: AI 3D creation service linked in Stefan 3D AI’s environment workflow.
resources.use_in_hub: Evaluate model generation as an optional asset-creation step; review current quotas and export terms.

resources.title: Learn3D AI environment course
resources.summary: Environment-building course linked by Stefan 3D AI, from rough concept to an Unreal scene.
resources.use_in_hub: Use for structured environment education; access and pricing follow the provider.

resources.title: Top3D AI tools directory
resources.summary: 3D AI tools directory linked by Stefan 3D AI.
resources.use_in_hub: Discover candidate tools, then check each provider’s actual capabilities and terms.

resources.title: LAST FRAME: realtime video adventure
resources.summary: Video-driven adventure experiment with branching generated clips and continuous live scenes.
resources.use_in_hub: Study its Next.js and fal-based workflow. Requires a server-side fal key and paid inference; license and Tari integration are not verified.

resources.title: Labyrinth procedural generation demo
resources.summary: dev_rygy procedural labyrinth demonstration distributed as a Windows download.
resources.use_in_hub: Study generated layouts. The linked download is a demo executable, not verified reusable source code.

resources.title: Shadertoy
resources.summary: Browser shader community and interactive graphics examples.
resources.use_in_hub: Learn GLSL and prototype visual effects. Review each shader’s individual license before incorporating code.

resources.title: React Bits
resources.summary: Animated React component collection
resources.use_in_hub: Select spotlight cards and an art-led hero example; inspect individual dependencies.

resources.title: Motion
resources.summary: React and JavaScript animation library
resources.use_in_hub: Use lazy-loaded motion features for reveal/layout transitions; preserve reduced motion.

resources.title: Awesome React Three Fiber
resources.summary: Curated R3F examples and learning links
resources.use_in_hub: Find a coherent showcase scene instead of writing scene infrastructure.

resources.title: Drei
resources.summary: Reusable helpers for React Three Fiber
resources.use_in_hub: Reuse model staging, environments and camera controls in optional 3D recipes.

resources.title: pmndrs UIKit
resources.summary: User interface primitives for three-dimensional scenes
resources.use_in_hub: Optional in-game spatial UI; preserve DOM navigation and forms.

resources.title: Rive React runtime
resources.summary: State-driven vector animation playback
resources.use_in_hub: Optional animated badges/characters with input-state bindings.

resources.title: Canvas Confetti
resources.summary: Browser confetti effect library
resources.use_in_hub: Bounded celebration at confirmed publish or achievement events.

resources.title: Pixi particle emitter
resources.summary: Particle simulation and editable configurations
resources.use_in_hub: Evaluate exact Pixi version compatibility; older editor formats need conversion.

resources.title: Awesome Gamedev
resources.summary: Aggregate game-making tools, assets and learning
resources.use_in_hub: Discovery source, not a tested bundle or an activity guarantee.

resources.title: Design Resources for Developers
resources.summary: Aggregated visual design and web resources
resources.use_in_hub: Find typography, UI kits and source assets for coherent themed presets.

resources.title: Kenney UI Pack
resources.summary: Ready-made game UI asset pack for buttons, panels and game interface studies.
resources.use_in_hub: Select concrete elements for the reuse-first gaming presentation kit.

resources.title: Gaming website composition references
resources.summary: Gaming-site inspiration catalogue; use for visual composition, not as an asset or code download.
resources.use_in_hub: Select concrete elements for the reuse-first gaming presentation kit.

resources.title: tsParticles: interactive particle effects
resources.summary: Configurable JavaScript particle effects with React components, trails, confetti and fireworks.
resources.use_in_hub: Use for tuned particle trails and celebration effects. Start with a small particle budget; respect Effects off and reduced motion.

resources.title: React Bits: Splash Cursor
resources.summary: React component demonstrating a flowing fluid cursor effect.
resources.use_in_hub: Reference for fluid motion and hero interactions. Evaluate GPU cost and keep the effect behind readable content; do not install the whole collection for one effect.

resources.title: Cursor Effects: trails and fairy dust
resources.summary: JavaScript cursor effects including trailing cursors, following dots, bubbles and fairy dust.
resources.use_in_hub: Useful for lightweight cursor inspiration and prototypes. Tune trail rate, density and colors; preserve native pointer accuracy and clean up with destroy().

resources.title: Codrops: dreamy interactive particles
resources.summary: Tutorial on interactive particle motion using Three.js, shaders and GPGPU.
resources.use_in_hub: Study flowing particle fields for hero art or game backgrounds. More complex than a cursor trail; profile on lower-powered devices.
